source.body:
### Bug Description

The logs panel loads the data of a sub-workflow when a node, such as Execute Workflow, ran one. If that load fails, n8n shows an error toast titled "Unable to load sub execution". The title is written in English straight into the code, so it does not get translated.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/28b1d8ad1ac3ac2ad0db6f2f4e616926996a8807/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/execution/logs/composables/useLogsExecutionData.ts#L148

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Make a workflow that calls a sub-workflow with the Execute Workflow node, and run it.
3. In the browser dev tools, block the request that loads the sub-workflow execution.
4. Open the logs panel and expand the Execute Workflow node.
5. The error toast title says "Unable to load sub execution" in English.

### Expected behavior

The toast title shows in the selected language, like the rest of the logs panel.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.49.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.49.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
